scripts.build: pnpm exec tsup src/index.ts --dts --format esm --external @eslint/js --external @stylistic/eslint-plugin --external typescript-eslint --external eslint-plugin-check-file --external eslint-plugin-react --external eslint-plugin-react-hooks --external eslint-plugin-react-refresh
scripts.release:patch: pnpm build && pnpm version patch && pnpm publish --no-git-checks
scripts.release:minor: pnpm build && pnpm version minor && pnpm publish --no-git-checks
scripts.release:major: pnpm build && pnpm version major && pnpm publish --no-git-checks
